notes: The threshold here is STRICT (every valid sample must pass), unlike the trajectory gate's 2-of-3. The key-gate suite has now run 6/6 five times over (#180, twice in #187, and the three runs of this baseline: 181s + 264s + 272s, --no-cache), with zero voided samples — it does not flake, so a single failure is signal and must not be absorbed by a threshold. The VOID rules still apply: a judge parse failure or a provider error is re-drawn, never counted as a K-case failure. If this suite ever starts flaking, loosen the threshold deliberately and record why — do not let it drift.
